quests.title: A Round on the Old Course
quests.summary: Earn a tee time on the Old Course at St Andrews, the home of golf, and win the round.

steps.text: Get the caddie's say-so: answer Old Tam's three questions about the course at the British Golf Museum. The plaques on the course know the answers.
Tell the Starter at the first tee you're ready, then beat all four players from the 1st to the 18th.

quests.reward: A Featherie (a charm: gale moves hit harder), the prize money, and standing in Scotland.

quests.title: Provisions for the Discovery
quests.summary: Help provision RRS Discovery, Scott's Dundee-built Antarctic ship, for a living history voyage.

steps.text: Fetch a crate of Dundee marmalade from Keiller's Jam Kitchen.
Get jute sacking from the Verdant Works mill.
Bring back an iron girdle, for oatcakes on the ice, from the Girdlesmith's Forge at Culross, over the Forth.
Prove you're fit for the ice: beat the Ice Master on board the Discovery.

quests.reward: A Jamlet that stowed away in the marmalade, Dundee cake, cranachan, and standing in Scotland.

quests.title: The McGonagall Night
quests.giver: The Landlady of the Silvery Tay
quests.summary: Write the worst poem in Dundee, in honour of William McGonagall, and beat the reigning champion.

steps.text: Find inspiration: see the Tay Whale at the McManus.
Go down to the quay by the old bridge stumps at night, and catch whatever crosses the Tay.
Back at the Silvery Tay: compose a truly dreadful poem and beat the Bard of Broughty Ferry.

quests.reward: Dundee marmalade, Forfar bridies, your name on the board, and standing in Scotland.
